task: Decide whether a contract ends before a cutoff. Jev cannot compare dates, so extract each part as a choice over a closed set and compare in code.
code_rule: Build new Date(year, month, day) from the three choices, each requiring confidence >= 0.8, then compare with the cutoff in code. Any not_stated means ask a human.

state.clause: This agreement remains in force until 7 February 2027, after which it renews annually unless either party gives notice.

end_month.instructions: In which month does the agreement in `clause` end?

criteria.not_stated: The clause does not give an end month.

end_year.instructions: In which year does the agreement in `clause` end?

criteria.not_stated: The clause does not give an end year.

end_day.instructions: On which day of the month does the agreement in `clause` end?

criteria.not_stated: The clause does not give a day of the month, or it is none of the listed days.
